name: Museum of Science and Industry
address: 5700 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60637
tagline: Captured U-boat, working coal mine, hands-on for kids. The most physical museum in the city.
description: Largest science museum in the Western Hemisphere. Houses U-505 (the only captured German submarine on US soil), a working coal mine, the Apollo 8 command module, and the famous transparent anatomical figures.
review_long:
MSI is built into the only surviving major building from the 1893 World's Columbian Exposition, and it remains the most physically engaging science museum in the country. U-505 — the only German submarine the US Navy ever captured — sits in a purpose-built underground hall. The working coal mine takes you down a real elevator shaft.

Go with kids if you have them. Go without kids and you'll still spend four hours.

tips.text: U-505 sub tour is timed and books out by noon — reserve at entry.
Park in the underground garage; surface lots fill on weekends.

distance_landmark: Hyde Park, 7.5 mi south of downtown
